content: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
author: Stephen Hawking
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

Stephen Hawking understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
